prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with shoulder injury after a hit while turning left. The patient had 27 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1252; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- It is not yet clear whether the injury came from this crash.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Some exam findings support the injury; other tests are normal.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a collision sustained while turning left, with complaints of right shoulder pain and restricted range of motion. Over the course of 27 visits, care consisted of physical therapy, home exercise instruction, and periodic reassessment. Treatment followed a typical progression, with visit frequency tapering as symptoms improved and strength and mobility returned toward baseline. Several examination findings are consistent with a soft tissue shoulder injury, including painful arc and reduced resistance testing, while other orthopedic and neurological tests remained within normal limits. No prior injury to the same shoulder region is documented in available history. At this time, it remains unclear whether the reported injury is fully attributable to this collision, and further records may be needed to clarify causation. Billing records reflect single, appropriately spaced charges for each service with no duplicate entries.
